properties.name: River Nar SSSI
properties.note: Grazing marsh and the most important valley grassland in west Norfolk (Scoping Report). About 0.5 km from the site.

properties.name: Boughton Fen SSSI
properties.note: Fen on shallow peat, with tall fen, scrub and rare moths. The Scoping Report puts it about 25 m from the site, across Oxborough Road.

properties.name: Hooks Well Meadows, Great Cressingham SSSI
Setchey SSSI
properties.note: Notified for geology. The Scoping Report puts it about 10 m from the site.

properties.name: Leziate, Sugar and Derby Fens SSSI
East Walton and Adcock's Common SSSI
Breckland Farmland SSSI
properties.note: Farmland important for stone curlew; part of the Breckland SPA area. The Scoping Report puts it about 2.6 km east of the site.

properties.name: Wiggenhall St. Germans SSSI
properties.note: Notified for geology. The Scoping Report puts it about 0.6 km north of the site.

properties.name: Islington Heronry SSSI
properties.note: Inside the site (Western Site). Notified for the largest breeding colony of grey herons in Norfolk, about 80 nests a year. The developer commits to a minimum 100 m buffer between the SSSI and any above-ground infrastructure (Scoping Report).
